scope: Merge document correction into the actual dirty main worktree only after isolated experiments; keep other local work uncommitted.
strategy: Preserve the main worktree baseline/reviewer/publication improvements; merge missing document copy guard, disabled style-rule behavior, host failure containment, scoped business tool policy, configurable budgets and document benchmark fixtures. Do not overwrite the newer main reviewer with the older document branch version.

experimentArms.baseline: Frozen actual main working tree plus the identical common baseline compatibility prerequisites and measurement harness; no document feature or copyFrom capability enabled.
experimentArms.candidate: Same frozen main tree plus resolved document branch; copyFrom explicitly enabled only for copy-contract document tasks.

selectedBaselineStrategy: For this explicit document-copy task only, materialRoots is empty: the actual user copy contract and project edit scope are independently extracted and audited. The complete immutable benchmark requirements remain declared document Ground Truth, are read natively and are compared in full by the opt-in copy guard. Ordinary design-task material defaults do not change.

Explain existing full-text fallback and source-only inventory shapes without supplying semantic decisions
Retain the coverage auditor's exact original evidence paths after native settlement so publication can independently re-verify them

providerConfiguration.credentials: User-authorized process memory only; neither configuration files nor committed artifacts contain credentials

acceptance: Candidate introduces no new relevant local test failures relative to baseline
